note: v2.2 plan 03 Phase A. Labels written before any judge answer was read. Presence is asked only for physical characters (narrators and the ship AI are excluded). Time labels 'unclear' when the text gives no cue.

transcript.speaker: DM Narrator
transcript.text: The guild hall is loud with evening drinkers; lanterns sway above the crowded job board.

transcript.speaker: Arin
transcript.text: "Pick something that pays, Max. My boots have holes in them."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I run a finger down the notices and stop at the one stamped with a sun. "This one. The Sun Ruins." I tear it off the board.

reachable.name: Accept the Mission
reachable.objective: Pick up the Sun Ruins mission from the board.

reachable.name: Return to the Guild
reachable.objective: Deliver the artifact to the Guild Master and claim your reward.

transcript.speaker: DM Narrator
transcript.text: Morning light slants through the shutters onto Ponticius's counter.

transcript.speaker: Ponticius
transcript.text: "Sign here. You leave the day after tomorrow, and not a day later."

transcript.speaker: Arin
transcript.text: "Two days to pack. Generous."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I sign the contract. "We'll get our gear together tonight and sort out who's coming."

reachable.name: Departure Preparations
reachable.objective: Decide whether to take Luke along before departing for the Sun Ruins.

reachable.name: Find the Artifact
reachable.objective: Recover the Sun's Heart Artifact from the inner chamber.

transcript.speaker: DM Narrator
transcript.text: At dawn the town gate creaks open; the desert beyond is still blue with shadow.

transcript.speaker: Luke
transcript.text: "Please, Max. I can carry the water. I won't slow you down."

transcript.speaker: Arin
transcript.text: "He'll follow us anyway. Better he walks where I can see him."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Fine. You come, Luke, but you stay behind Arin the whole way." We head out through the gate together.

reachable.name: Travel with Luke
reachable.objective: Reach the Sun Ruins with Luke and face the sphinx's riddle.

reachable.name: Return to the Guild
reachable.objective: Deliver the artifact to the Guild Master and claim your reward.

transcript.speaker: DM Narrator
transcript.text: The sun hangs straight overhead; the desert road shimmers and there is no shade anywhere.

transcript.speaker: Luke
transcript.text: "Is it always this hot? My water's nearly gone."

transcript.speaker: Arin
transcript.text: "Drink slower. Ponticius won't be sending a rescue."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I hand Luke my flask and we keep walking east.

reachable.name: Find the Artifact
reachable.objective: Recover the Sun's Heart Artifact from the inner chamber.

reachable.name: Return to the Guild
reachable.objective: Deliver the artifact to the Guild Master and claim your reward.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The engine room is a cage of pipes and red warning light; the reactor hums unevenly.

transcript.speaker: Pell
transcript.text: "Coolant loop two is fried. I can bypass it if you hold this valve."

transcript.speaker: Captain Okafor
transcript.text: Okafor's voice crackles over the comm from the bridge: "How long, Pell?"

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I grab the valve. "Give me the wrench, Pell. Let's bring her back up."

reachable.name: Restore Main Power
reachable.objective: Bring the reactor back online.

reachable.name: Abandon Ship
reachable.objective: Get everyone into the escape pods.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: It is 0300 ship time. On the bridge, every console is flashing amber.

transcript.speaker: Captain Okafor
transcript.text: "The reactor's past saving. Everyone to the pods, now."

transcript.speaker: HALO
transcript.text: "Escape pods one through four are primed."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "You heard her. Pods." I follow Okafor off the bridge toward the pod bay.

reachable.name: Abandon Ship
reachable.objective: Get everyone into the escape pods.

reachable.name: Restore Main Power
reachable.objective: Bring the reactor back online.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The cargo bay is freezing; frost creeps along the crates.

transcript.speaker: Pell
transcript.text: "Hull patches are in crate six. We'll need at least three for the breach on deck three."

transcript.speaker: Captain Okafor
transcript.text: Okafor pries open crate six. "Take four. I'm not doing this twice."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I load the patches onto the cart and push it toward the lift to deck three.

reachable.name: Seal the Breach
reachable.objective: Patch the hull breach on deck three.

reachable.name: Abandon Ship
reachable.objective: Get everyone into the escape pods.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The ship's night cycle has dimmed the crew-quarters corridor to a blue glow.

transcript.speaker: Pell
transcript.text: Pell's voice comes over the intercom: "Reactor's stable for now. Get some sleep."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I kick off my boots and lie down on my bunk, staring at the ceiling.

reachable.name: Seal the Breach
reachable.objective: Patch the hull breach on deck three.

reachable.name: Abandon Ship
reachable.objective: Get everyone into the escape pods.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Midnight at the Blue Anchor: neon hums, smoke hangs under the ceiling, and Maeve is halfway through her last set.

transcript.speaker: Maeve
transcript.text: Maeve sings with her eyes closed, one hand on the microphone.

transcript.speaker: Mae Hollis
transcript.text: Mae leans in beside me. "She's scared. Look at her hands."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "After her set, we talk to Maeve. Quietly."

reachable.name: Turn Maeve
reachable.objective: Get Maeve to name who pays the harbor police.

reachable.name: Confront Brandt
reachable.objective: Make the lieutenant admit who pays him.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: A gray dawn creeps over the harbor cranes. At the end of pier nine, Lt. Brandt takes a thick envelope from a man in a wet coat.

transcript.speaker: Mae Hollis
transcript.text: Mae crouches next to me behind the fish crates. "That's our proof."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Now, Mae. We step out and take him before he pockets it."

reachable.name: Confront Brandt
reachable.objective: Make the lieutenant admit who pays him.

reachable.name: Turn Maeve
reachable.objective: Get Maeve to name who pays the harbor police.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Afternoon light cuts through the blinds of the police station's third floor.

transcript.speaker: Lt. Brandt
transcript.text: Brandt looks up from his desk. "Hollis. You're off your beat."

transcript.speaker: Mae Hollis
transcript.text: "So are you, Lieutenant. Pier nine, six a.m."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I drop the photos from the docks on Brandt's desk. "Who pays you?"

reachable.name: Confront Brandt
reachable.objective: Make the lieutenant admit who pays him.

reachable.name: Find the Ledger
reachable.objective: Recover the smuggler's ledger.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Rain hammers Mercer Street; the streetlights flicker in the dark.

transcript.speaker: Maeve
transcript.text: Maeve walks between us under Mae's umbrella. "The ledger's in the back room of the laundry on Pike. Under the floor."

transcript.speaker: Mae Hollis
transcript.text: "Then that's where we're going."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I turn up my collar and head for Pike Street.

reachable.name: Find the Ledger
reachable.objective: Recover the smuggler's ledger.

reachable.name: Confront Brandt
reachable.objective: Make the lieutenant admit who pays him.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Night has fallen; a single candle lights the long portrait gallery.

transcript.speaker: Graves
transcript.text: "The family records are kept in the library, sir. If you wish, I shall take you."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Lead the way, Graves."

reachable.name: Search the Library
reachable.objective: Find the family records in the library.

reachable.name: Confront Lady Ashworth
reachable.objective: Make her explain why the portraits move.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: In the library, late afternoon sun falls across the reading table where Lady Ashworth sits with a closed book.

transcript.speaker: Lady Ashworth
transcript.text: "You are persistent, Mr. Max. I will grant you that."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Lady Ashworth, why do the portraits move? I want the truth."

reachable.name: Confront Lady Ashworth
reachable.objective: Make her explain why the portraits move.

reachable.name: Leave the Manor
reachable.objective: Pack and leave Ashworth Hall before nightfall.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: First light in the kitchens: the ovens are cold and the copper pans still hang in rows.

transcript.speaker: Graves
transcript.text: Graves polishes the silver without looking up. "Breakfast is at eight, sir."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I pour myself some water and sit down on a stool to watch him work.

reachable.name: Confront Lady Ashworth
reachable.objective: Make her explain why the portraits move.

reachable.name: Leave the Manor
reachable.objective: Pack and leave Ashworth Hall before nightfall.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Evening in the garden; the hedges throw long shadows across the gravel.

transcript.speaker: Lady Ashworth
transcript.text: "Your carriage is ready, Mr. Max. You will leave tonight."

transcript.speaker: Graves
transcript.text: Graves stands behind her with my bag in his hand.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Then we go." I take the bag from Graves and walk toward the carriage.

reachable.name: Leave the Manor
reachable.objective: Pack and leave Ashworth Hall before nightfall.

reachable.name: Search the Library
reachable.objective: Find the family records in the library.

((Could the narrator describe the room in more detail?))
Can you make Ponticius offer double the reward? I want more gold.
Please don't have Luke die in this story, ok?
(OOC: Mae should be the one who finds the ledger)
Stop the scene here, I want to save and continue tomorrow.
Regenerate that, Graves wouldn't talk like that.
"Stop!" I shout at the guard. "Skip the formalities and let us through."
I ask Arin to be less sarcastic for once.
"Double the reward, Ponticius, or find another fool."
I scribble a note to myself: ask Maeve about the ledger tomorrow.
"HALO, describe the room. Every sensor reading."
I grab Luke by the shoulders. "Don't you dare die on me out there."
"Save your breath, Brandt. We know everything."
I take a deep breath and keep climbing the stairs.
"Continue the story, old man. What happened to the last crew?"
